Copy the [installation test record](https://github.com/Icend89/codex-elementor-toolkit/blob/main/docs/validation.md#record-a-real-installation-test)
and fill it using observed results. Identify the fixture and repository commit, exact
environment versions and database type, import/edit/save/reopen outcomes, requested
and measured frontend widths, and the export/inspection/fresh-reimport results.
Attach only original, sanitized evidence. Leave unperformed checks marked pending.
